name: MeshCentral
tagline: Remote management & control of your machines
description: Full computer remote management: web-based remote desktop, terminal, file transfer and monitoring for Windows/Linux/macOS via MeshAgent. TeamViewer without the cloud.
compose:
services:
  meshcentral:
    image: ghcr.io/yliang4/meshcentral-docker:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:4430"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/opt/meshcentral/meshcentral-data
    restart: unless-stopped
